overview_description.description: iLab Marine is helping fish farmers reduce waste and increase the efficiency of feeding operations. We provide IoT feeders for inland aquaculture farmers who struggle with the high cost of fish feed. These feeders help farmers reduce inaccuracies with manual feeding and help them save up to 20% of the cost of the operation, as well as maintain healthy water quality. The feeder is controlled via a mobile application, where farmers can schedule feeding times and the quantity.  We empower ordinary farmers with simple and comprehensive data analytics.  Our mobile app displays farm health metrics and signifies clients about abnormal behavior. It also helps farmers predict future feed requirements and when to harvest.
